d: Russia and Ukraine have sharply intensified their attacks just days after US-mediated peace talks in Abu Dhabi ended without a breakthrough. Ukraine struck the Kerch Bridge linking Russia with occupied Crimea for a second consecutive day. Russia also says it intercepted over 1400 Ukrainian drones overnight — the largest one-day figure Moscow has reported during the war. Russia responded with missile and drone attacks on Ukraine, damaging two major bridges in Kyiv and striking other infrastructure. The escalation comes as negotiations remain stuck over fundamental disagreements. Russia…
